const nickname = this.userInfos[userId]?.nickname; if (!nickname && this.userInfoProvider) { const userInfo = await this.userInfoProvider([userId]); if (userInfo) { logDebug('Successfully retrieved user info:', userInfo); this.setUserInfo({ [userId]: userInfo[0], }); } else { logError('获取用户信息失败', userId); } } logDebug('User info:', this.userInfos); const remoteVideoInfo: VideoWindowProps = { id: `remote-${userId}`, isLocalVideo: false, muted: !hasAudioTrack, // 🔧 修复：有音频轨道 = 未静音，无音频轨道 = 静音 cameraEnabled: true, // 摄像头开启 nickname: nickname || userId, avatar: this.userInfos[userId]?.avatarUrl, // 🔧 修复：设置正确的视频流，用于最小化窗口显示 stream: remoteVideoStream, isWaiting: false, // 明确设置不在等待状态，用于替换等待窗口 }; const updatedVideoInfo: VideoWindowProps = { id: `remote-${userId}`, isLocalVideo: false, muted: false, // 🔧 修复：音频发布时，用户取消静音了 cameraEnabled: cameraEnabled, // cameraEnabled: false, // 摄像头关闭 nickname: this.userInfos[userId]?.nickname || userId, avatar: this.userInfos[userId]?.avatarUrl, // 保持当前的视频流状态 stream: cameraEnabled ? this.getRemoteVideoStream(user.uid) : undefined, isWaiting: false, // 明确设置不在等待状态 };
